title: 分析师Anthony Stevens：AI热潮估值承压，如何配置权益资产？
speaker: Anthony Stevens

segments.en: I think this is really about coming into the fundamentals and thinking about the earnings, because the way these are priced, the way these are rated at the moment, is to see a very dramatic fall in earnings, potentially even negative earnings at some point in the cycle.
segments.zh: 我认为这实际上要回归基本面，思考盈利情况。因为当前这些资产的定价和评级方式，预示着盈利将大幅下滑，甚至可能在周期某个阶段出现负盈利。

segments.en: And how long was that cycle? I mean, how do you map this out? I mean, say it's 2027, some say it's 2030. I mean, how much runway do you think this sort of AI boom has at this moment? Yeah, I mean, this is the question that everyone wants to ask, and I think this is, it's really difficult.
segments.zh: 这个周期有多长？如何规划？有人说2027年，有人说2030年。你认为这轮AI热潮还有多少发展空间？这是每个人都想问的问题，确实很难回答。

segments.en: I often think about when you have an edge in a stock. And two years ago, when these companies were trading at really, really low price to books, I think that was a bit easier. At this point, as I sort of said, the valuations or the ratings are very low. The earnings expectations are pretty high, but they've got to come back a long way to not justify those ratings.
segments.zh: 我经常思考何时在权益资产上具有优势。两年前，这些公司市净率极低，那时更容易判断。目前估值或评级很低，盈利预期很高，但盈利需要大幅回落才能证明当前评级不合理。

segments.en: So I think it's difficult at this point. So I think you're either positioned, and I think the real question is, is how much weight or how much risk do you want to allocate to this part of the market? And then you can decide how much you want in physical AI, how much you want in memory, or how much you want in photonics.
segments.zh: 所以目前很难。要么你已经布局，真正的问题是：你愿意将多少权重或风险配置到这一市场领域？然后决定多少配置到实体AI、存储或光子学。

segments.en: But I think it's really around that question about how much one leave allocated to this part of the market.
segments.zh: 但核心问题还是：应该在这一市场领域配置多少。
